        },
        Data::Enum(data) => data.variants.iter().map(|v| v.ident.to_string()).collect(),
        Data::Union(_) => Vec::new(),

1: use proc_macro::TokenStream;
2: use quote::quote;
3: use syn::parse::{Parse, ParseStream};
4: use syn::{Data, DeriveInput, Fields, Ident, Token, Type, parse_macro_input};
5: 
6: #[proc_macro_derive(CodeGen)]
7: pub fn derive_codegen(input: TokenStream) -> TokenStream {
8:     let input = parse_macro_input!(input as DeriveInput);
9:     match expand_codegen(&input) {
10:         Ok(tokens) => tokens.into(),
11:         Err(err) => err.to_compile_error().into(),
12:     }
13: }
14: 
15: fn expand_codegen(input: &DeriveInput) -> syn::Result<proc_macro2::TokenStream> {
16:     let name = &input.ident;
17:     let names = generated_names(&input.data);
18:     let count = names.len();
19: 
20:     Ok(quote! {
21:         impl #name {
22:             pub const FIELD_COUNT: usize = #count;
23: 
24:             pub fn field_names() -> &'static [&'static str] {
25:                 &[#(#names),*]
26:             }
27:         }
28:     })
29: }
30: 
31: fn generated_names(data: &Data) -> Vec<String> {
32:     match data {
33:         Data::Struct(data) => match &data.fields {
34:             Fields::Named(fields) => fields
35:                 .named
36:                 .iter()
37:                 .filter_map(|field| field.ident.as_ref())
38:                 .map(ToString::to_string)
39:                 .collect(),
40:             Fields::Unnamed(_) | Fields::Unit => Vec::new(),
41:         },
42:         Data::Enum(data) => data
43:             .variants
44:             .iter()
45:             .map(|variant| variant.ident.to_string())
46:             .collect(),
47:         Data::Union(_) => Vec::new(),
48:     }
49: }
50: 
51: struct StructSpec {
52:     name: Ident,
53:     fields: Vec<(Ident, Type)>,
54: }
55: 
56: impl Parse for StructSpec {
57:     fn parse(input: ParseStream) -> syn::Result<Self> {
58:         let name: Ident = input.parse()?;
59:         let content;
60:         syn::braced!(content in input);
61: 
62:         let mut fields = Vec::new();
63:         while !content.is_empty() {
64:             let field: Ident = content.parse()?;
65:             content.parse::<Token![:]>()?;
66:             let ty: Type = content.parse()?;
67:             fields.push((field, ty));
68: 
69:             if content.peek(Token![,]) {
70:                 content.parse::<Token![,]>()?;
71:             } else {
72:                 break;
73:             }
74:         }
75: 
76:         Ok(StructSpec { name, fields })
77:     }
78: }
79: 
80: #[proc_macro]
81: pub fn make_struct(input: TokenStream) -> TokenStream {
82:     let spec = parse_macro_input!(input as StructSpec);
83:     let name = &spec.name;
84:     let field_names: Vec<&Ident> = spec.fields.iter().map(|(ident, _)| ident).collect();
85:     let field_types: Vec<&Type> = spec.fields.iter().map(|(_, ty)| ty).collect();
86: 
87:     quote! {
88:         #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
89:         pub struct #name {
90:             #(pub #field_names: #field_types),*
91:         }
92: 
93:         impl #name {
94:             pub fn new(#(#field_names: #field_types),*) -> Self {
95:                 Self { #(#field_names),* }
96:             }
97:         }
98:     }
99:     .into()
100: }
